injections.name: the-save-step-is-read-as-a-second-restore
injections.why: THE EXACT DEFECT THIS ROUND EXISTS TO REFUSE, expressed as code: `Post Cache x` contains `Cache `, so testing the restore prefix first files every save as a restore. The cache then appears to cost only its restore — which is precisely the arithmetic the ledger carried, and the one that made a net-negative cache look like a net-positive one

injections.name: half-a-pair-is-priced-as-a-whole-cache
injections.why: a restore with no save prices a cache at half its cost, silently and in the cheap direction. The refusal is what keeps a shape this program was not written for from arriving as a number

injections.name: a-step-that-never-ran-is-priced-at-zero
injections.why: a zero JOINS the sample and pulls every summary towards a cache that is cheaper than it is; `None` leaves it out and says so. This is the same distinction the whole round is about, one level down

injections.name: stamps-that-run-backwards-are-read-as-almost-a-day
injections.why: a SKIPPED job really does report them — the recording carries `14:01:37` to `14:01:36` — and without the ceiling the midnight carry turns one second the wrong way into 86 399, a number that would dominate every total on the page

injections.name: an-unreadable-stamp-becomes-midnight
injections.why: a clock this program cannot read must refuse, not answer zero: a duration measured from a stamp nobody parsed is a number with no provenance, and it lands in a median a decision is taken from

injections.name: a-run-read-short-is-priced-as-a-cheaper-run
injections.why: a job missing from the answer is a cache whose cost is missing from the total, and fewer is the direction that reads as cheap. `total_count` is the only thing in the jobs answer that can catch it

injections.name: a-short-page-of-runs-is-taken-as-the-whole-sample
injections.why: a sample that quietly shrank looks TIGHTER than it is, which is fatal for a measurement whose whole subject is spread. The runs endpoint's `total_count` counts every run ever, so the law here is not the jobs endpoint's and cannot be borrowed from it

injections.name: a-summary-of-nothing-prints-as-zeroes
injections.why: the empty answer that reads like a clean one. A cache that never ran in the sample and a cache that cost nothing are different facts, and only one of them is news

injections.name: the-median-is-averaged-into-a-value-nobody-measured
injections.why: every number this prints should be one that was observed; a mean of two middles is a second kind of number sharing a column with the first, and on an even sample it is not any run's cost

injections.name: the-timestamps-become-optional-to-serde
injections.why: R1136's trap, one gate over: serde treats a DERIVED `Option` field as optional, so a body that stopped carrying `started_at` reads as a run where no step ever started — every cache free, silently, in the direction that makes this whole measurement disappear

injections.name: two-jobs-restoring-one-archive-are-merged-into-one-price
injections.why: a cache is a job's: two jobs restoring the same archive pay for it separately, and merging them reports one price for two costs — which halves the overhead of exactly the shared archives this repository has most of
